name: gas-enterprise-stack
description: Zero Gambiarras: Professional Google Apps Script Stack

scripts.push:web: npm run build:web && npx clasp push --force
scripts.push:auto: npm run build:auto && npx clasp push --force
scripts.dev:web: npx nodemon --watch src -e ts,html,json,css --exec "npm run push:web"
scripts.dev:auto: npx nodemon --watch src -e ts,json --exec "npm run push:auto"
